executive_summary: Enforces K.4 headline character limit (≤90 chars) via new validation gate VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE. Reads from staging_buffer, blocks file writes on violation.

VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE.description: Validates K.4 headline character count ≤90. Reads from staging_buffer, cannot access artist_output.

on_fail.message: K.4 headline exceeds 90 character limit. Actual: {actual_chars} chars. Text: '{headline_text[:100]}...'

VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE.on_pass: Log '✅ VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE: K.4 headline is {actual_chars} chars (≤90)'

changes.description: Update validation gate execution order to include headline check
Add headline character validation to QA Report Section 2
Update staging buffer to include character count for K.4
Add critical rule for headline character limit
content: K.4 REQUIREMENT (v1.6.7): Headline MUST be ≤90 characters total
VALIDATION (v1.6.7): VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE MUST validate K.4 character count

changes.description: Add headline character limit test suite

smoke_tests.name: Headline exactly 90 characters
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with exactly 90 chars, verify passes

smoke_tests.name: Headline 91 characters
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with 91 chars, verify fails

smoke_tests.name: Headline 89 characters
smoke_tests.check: Generate headline with 89 chars, verify passes

edge_case_tests.name: Whitespace-only headline
edge_case_tests.check: Generate headline with only spaces, verify halts
edge_case_tests.expected: HALT with 'K.4 headline contains only whitespace'

integration_tests.name: QA Report displays headline character count
integration_tests.check: Verify Section 2.1 shows actual character count
integration_tests.expected: Table row with K.4 char count

integration_tests.name: Headline regeneration on failure
integration_tests.check: Generate 100-char headline, verify regenerates up to 3 times
integration_tests.expected: Regeneration attempts logged, eventual pass or halt

integration_tests.name: File write blocked on headline violation
integration_tests.check: Generate 100-char headline, verify NO files written
integration_tests.expected: Zero output files, error report only

headline_character_limit_success: ✅ K.4 headline validated for ≤90 character limit
✅ Headlines exceeding 90 chars trigger validation failure
✅ File writes blocked when headline >90 chars
✅ QA Report Section 2.1 displays headline character count
✅ Regeneration mechanism triggers on headline violation (max 3 attempts)

validation_checkpoints.name: Headline character count validation
checks: QA Report Section 2.1 shows character count

success_criteria: QA Report Section 2.1 displays headline character count
ZERO headlines exceeding 90 chars in production
deployment_steps: 2. Verify VG_HEADLINE_CHARACTER_COMPLIANCE added to validation_gates array
3. Generate test headline with exactly 90 chars → verify passes
4. Generate test headline with 91 chars → verify fails (ValidationException)
5. Verify QA Report Section 2.1 displays character count
6. Run all 155 tests (147 existing + 8 new headline tests)
7. If all pass → Deploy to production
failure_indicators: ❌ Headlines exceeding 90 chars do NOT trigger validation failure
❌ QA Report missing Section 2.1 headline character count
❌ Validation gate reads from artist_output instead of staging_buffer
❌ Empty or whitespace-only headlines not caught
